```python
def tokenize(source):
    tokens = []
    i = 0
    n = len(source)
    while i < n:
        c = source[i]
        if c in ' \t\n\r':
            i += 1
        elif c == ';':
            # Skip to end of line
            while i < n and source[i] != '\n':
                i += 1
        elif c == '(':
            tokens.append('(')
            i += 1
        elif c == ')':
            tokens.append(')')
            i += 1
        elif c == "'":
            tokens.append("'")
            i += 1
        elif c == '"':
            # Read string
            i += 1
            s = []
            while i < n and source[i] != '"':
                if source[i] == '\\':
                    if i + 1 < n:
                        esc = source[i+1]
                        if esc == '"':
                            s.append('"')
                            i += 2
                        elif esc == '\\':
                            s.append('\\')
                            i += 2
                        elif esc == 'n':
                            s.append('\n')
                            i += 2
                        else:
                            raise SchemeError("invalid escape")
                    else:
                        raise SchemeError("unterminated string")
                else:
                    s.append(source[i])
                    i += 1
            if i >= n:
                raise SchemeError("unterminated string")
            i += 1  # skip closing "
            tokens.append(('string', ''.join(s)))
        else:
            # Read a token (symbol, number, #t, #f, .)
            start = i
            while i < n and source[i] not in ' \t\n\r()"\'':
                i += 1
            token = source[start:i]
            tokens.append(token)
    return tokens
```
